purpose: Test whether a frozen normalized E/A/U/W gate profile plus only the target empty/full endpoints predicts every intermediate background subset for grouped MLP6--7 across templates and syntax.
data_status: RETROSPECTIVE_FROZEN_RECEIPT_REANALYSIS; predictions are frozen before inspecting subset-level prediction errors, but no new text or model outcome is opened

binding_evidence.finding: Valid matched-text complete E/A/U/W/X full-response lattice with two templates per number direction.
Valid fronted-OOD complete E/A/U/W-by-X response lattice with one cell per number direction.
Normalized attribution profiles transfer across templates and syntax, while exact factor ordering does not.

novelty_audit: Authority searches for MLP6-7 subset prediction, additive background prediction, background-subset transfer, endpoint-calibrated background, and held-out composition subsets found no prior event performing this test.
Existing receipts decompose full lattices or compare aggregate Shapley profiles; none freezes coefficients from one cell and predicts the fourteen non-endpoint subsets of another cell.
map: For a target cell define q(S) as the causal margin effect of installing X=MLP6+7 in background subset S. Take signed normalized source coefficients p_f from a different frozen cell. Calibrate only q(empty) and q(EAUW) in the target, then predict q_hat(S)=q(empty)+(q(EAUW)-q(empty))*sum_{f in S} p_f for all fourteen intermediate subsets. No target intermediate value, coefficient fit, or parameter optimization is allowed.

predictions.pred_a_receipts_and_endpoints_close: All bound receipts validate, all six lattices are complete, and the endpoint-calibrated law reproduces empty/full endpoints to 1e-12.
predictions.pred_b_matched_template_transfer: Using the other matched template in the same direction, every target cell has intermediate-subset MAE divided by |endpoint shift| at most 0.20 and maximum normalized error at most 0.45.
predictions.pred_c_matched_to_ood_transfer: Using the mean matched profile in the same direction, both OOD cells satisfy normalized MAE at most 0.20 and maximum normalized error at most 0.45.
predictions.pred_d_ood_to_matched_transfer: Using the OOD profile in the same direction, all four matched cells satisfy normalized MAE at most 0.20 and maximum normalized error at most 0.45.
predictions.pred_e_cardinality_unbiased: For subset cardinalities one, two, and three, the mean signed residual normalized by |endpoint shift| has absolute value at most 0.10 in every cross-syntax transfer cell.
predictions.pred_f_nontrivial_over_uniform: Transferred coefficients reduce aggregate squared error versus the uniform four-factor profile by at least 10% in both matched-to-OOD and OOD-to-matched directions.

null: Failure of b-d means a stable Shapley profile is descriptive but not an executable subset-composition law. Failure of e localizes systematic missing interactions by subset cardinality. Failure of f means factor-specific coefficients add no predictive value beyond endpoint interpolation. Preserve misses; do not refit coefficients or relax bars.
closed_claims: global coefficient sharing without endpoint calibration
